title: Sabr in my life
subject: Islamic Studies
source: Seeded from islamic-studies/y8 lesson 30 (Pupil PDF worksheet: sabr in my life)
intro: Lesson 30: Character in the Seerah: patience. To understand sabr as shown by the Prophet ﷺ in the hardest moments of the Seerah and how we apply it

questions.q: Explain how the Prophet ﷺ showed sabr at Ta'if. (4 marks, our own question)
questions.a: Rejected and harmed, he refused the offer to destroy them and hoped their descendants would worship Allah (Bukhari and Muslim): patience joined with mercy.
questions.model: Point 1: he bore harm without revenge. Develop: he was stoned at Ta'if. Point 2: he chose mercy. Develop: he refused the angel's offer and hoped their children would worship Allah (Bukhari and Muslim).

questions.q: The patient will be given their reward ...

Sabr in my life, in the portal response box: choose one real challenge (exams, a sibling, a disappointment), name the kind of sabr, and plan three actions and a du'a. Start: 'My challenge is ... This needs sabr ... because ...'
questions.a: A real challenge, the right kind of sabr, three practical actions, a du'a
questions.model: Teacher writes: 'My challenge is revising when I would rather play. This needs sabr in obeying Allah, because seeking knowledge is worship.'

questions.q: what did Allah give the Prophet ﷺ soon after Ta'if?
Back to our ponder: is patience just waiting?
questions.a: No: it is active, holding firm with action and du'a
